stem_book: A bullet of mass m moving with a horizontal velocity v strikes a stationary block of mass M suspended by a string of length L. The bullet gets embedded in the block. The maximum angle made by the string after impact is θ = cos⁻¹[1 − m²v²/(xgL(M+m)²)], find x?
reason: Manifest stem had corrupt HTML entity in cos⁻¹; replaced.
work: V = mv/(M+m); V² = 2gL(1−cosθ) → cosθ = 1 − m²v²/[2gL(M+m)²] → x = 2
